Context: 7. Central Administrative Tribunal

Applications.are decided on a perusal, by the Members, of the documents filed by both the sides, written representations made and hearing the oral arguments advanced at the time of hearing. The Tribunal has been vested  
with power to hold an .enquiry as provided in the Act, if necessary.
